scoring_justification: Energy differences and rippling amplitudes are fixed deterministic numbers from the EAM potential; the verifier cannot re-run the full Monte Carlo simulations, so result-level comparison against paper-reported values within tolerance is used. Structure factor is checked via structural audit of peak positions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold energy differences and rippling amplitudes for comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Surface Science 1987, Foiles, reported values in text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from paper's numeric statements (eV for energies, Å for rippling) converted to meV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the publication's own reported numbers.

outputs.description: Energy differences for Au incorporation processes on Cu(100).
Structure factor S(k) for Au atoms on each surface.
Surface rippling amplitudes for the three low-index Cu surfaces.

output_contract.notes: The structure factor is scored on presence and qualitative width of expected fractional-order peaks; it does not demand exact S(k) values. The rippling and energy differences are compared to paper-reported values with a hidden tolerance that accounts for typical implementation differences (e.g., slab size, convergence).

steps.description: Check presence of integer-order and fractional-order peaks for each surface; for (110) also check directional peak width description.
